title: Applicability.
bodyText: This part applies to an anatomical gift or amendment to, revocation of, or refusal to make an anatomical gift, whenever made.
bodyHtml: [§327-3]  Applicability.  This part applies to an anatomical gift or amendment to, revocation of, or refusal to make an anatomical gift, whenever made. [L 2008, c 122, pt of §1]
